notes:
### Bugfixes

- Dorcel reactive recovery no longer restarts immediately when a normal periodic stall begins.
- Added a central recovery lock so watcher and diagnostic paths cannot trigger duplicate reactive or token-refresh handoffs for the same stall.
- A continuous long OutputPicture freeze is now treated as one stall event instead of being detected repeatedly after cooldown expiry.

### Improvements

- Reactive recovery is now conservative: Kodi is allowed to recover naturally first, and a live-edge handoff is considered only after roughly 12 seconds of continuous freezing.
- Late reactive recovery proceeds only when the HLS manifest is moving forward again, is not stale, has no manifest error, and Kodi is still producing current OutputPicture timeouts.
- If the source is still stale or unhealthy, recovery waits instead of reopening into the same bad source window.
- If Kodi recovers by itself, no handoff is performed.
- Planned Dorcel token refreshes keep using the existing prepared-session strategy and remain protected by the same central handoff lock.

### Important

- Unlimited, Auto Channels Check, Site/IPTV behavior, One Channel, 15/30/65/125-minute timing, automatic log saving, Save Log Only, Shutdown/Sleep, Check Lock, AlarmClock/watchdog and the Dorcel token-expiry fallback remain otherwise unchanged.
